item.title: DEATHcon2023: Practical DEATH by Velociraptor
item.description:
This workshop was presented at DEATHcon in November 2023. It combines an introduction to Velociraptor and VQL with practical investigation and detection scenarios. Follow the six labs in order, or choose a topic below. Five labs include links to the original video recordings.

Before you start #

The original labs use a Windows 10 or later virtual machine with administrator access, Velociraptor GUI mode and internet access for downloads and artifact imports. The GUI walkthrough used Velociraptor 0.7.0-3 at the time of writing. The UEFI lab also requires a UEFI-enabled VM.

item.title: Content Management Like a Boss!
item.description:
Content management is one of the most under rated Velociraptor capabilities used by mature users. This talk will walk through some basics of content management, introduce automation and hopefully leave you with actionable ideas on how to do Velociraptor Content like a boss.

item.title: DEATHcon 2022 Velociraptor workshop
item.description:
DEATHcon Velociraptor workshop was held November 2022. We cover some basic VQL use cases including NTFS, Event Logs, Yara and memory artifacts.

The workshop was implemented with Velociraptor 0.6.6 although the data generation can be applied to any version.

item.title: Notebook and VQL - data munging your way to victory!
item.description:
Velociraptor notebook is a feature that supercharges analysis and speeds up many components of incident response. New users are often intimidated by advanced VQL and don’t know where to start. This talk aims to shed some light on data manipulation in VQL and provide some practical examples that can be taken away for better artifacts and analysis.

Presentation slides

item.title: WMI Event Consumers: what are you missing?
item.description: Find WMI event consumers that common collection methods miss, including persistence in custom namespaces. Covers collection and detection with Velociraptor.

item.title: Cobalt Strike Payload Discovery And Data Manipulation In VQL
item.description: Discover encoded Cobalt Strike payloads in MSBuild task files, collect them with Velociraptor and use VQL to decode payloads and extract indicators.

item.title: Endpoint Hunting in an AntiEDR World
item.description:
With the proliferation of EDR we have seen attackers at all levels upping their game to bypass brittle (and not so brittle) endpoint detection. This talk showcases the background to EDR technology and some practical real world examples of detection bypasses.

Originally presented at a local SANs and community event (modification with additional presentations since).

item.title: Binary Rename 2
item.description: Compare YARA and PowerShell approaches to finding renamed executables on disk, with code examples and detection limitations.

item.title: Blue Team Hacks - Binary Rename
item.description: Detect renamed Windows binaries by comparing executable metadata with process names and paths. Includes a proof of concept and its limitations.

item.title: Powershell Download Cradles
item.description: Compare PowerShell download cradles and their network and endpoint traces, with test scripts to help assess detection coverage.

item.title: Blue Team Hacks - WMI Eventing
item.description: Use WMI event subscriptions to monitor processes and trigger file collection on older Windows systems with visibility gaps.
